issues.where: the pale rock ledges spanning the chasm in the middle of the frame
issues.what: the slabs float in mid-air with no support, read as smooth extruded clay or plastic shapes with soft rounded edges, and one blocky piece sits on top like a placed prop; they do not look like the same rock as the cliff wall
issues.fix: anchor the ledges into the cliff wall, give them fractured edges and bedding that matches the wall, or remove them

issues.where: the pale ledge surface, crop x 42 to 58% y 58 to 75% (also set-B-05 crop x 42 to 58% y 25 to 42%)
issues.what: a single low-detail texture is stretched along the ledge with repeating dark specks and thin horizontal streaks; the surface is soft and flat at native size with no real relief
issues.fix: use a higher-resolution rock material with displacement and break up the repeated speck pattern

issues.where: the rubble at the right, crop x 83 to 100% y 58 to 75%
issues.what: boulders are faceted low-poly blocks with hard straight edges, and thin triangular shards stick out of the slope like intersecting planes; the slope texture is a smeared marble-like pattern
issues.fix: use sculpted, weathered boulders that rest on the slope, remove the intersecting shards, and add scree and dust at their bases

issues.where: the frond strands, crop x 0 to 17% y 58 to 75% and x 0 to 17% y 25 to 42%
issues.what: the fronds are flat ribbons and stair-stepped, aliased line strands with hard cut ends; some strips read as flat cards with a striped texture
issues.fix: render the strands as tapered round fibres with anti-aliasing and soft translucent tips

issues.where: the frond edges against the bright sky, crops x 0 to 17% y 25 to 42% and x 42 to 58% y 25 to 42%
issues.what: strand edges show a dither or screen-door pattern and jagged aliasing where they cross the bright haze
issues.fix: raise the hair samples or the transparency quality so thin strands resolve smoothly

issues.where: the droplets hanging on and falling from the fronds
issues.what: the water reads as identical white dots and short pill streaks spread evenly through the plant; they light nothing and do not wet the strands
issues.fix: vary the drop size and spacing, cluster them at the strand tips, and add refraction and wet sheen to the strands near them

issues.where: the base of the plant at lower left
issues.what: the trunk is a smooth, untextured clay-like cylinder that sits on the ground with no roots, debris or contact shadow
issues.fix: give the trunk bark or fibre texture, and roots or debris where it meets the ground with a proper contact shadow

issues.where: the cliff wall, crop x 83 to 100% y 25 to 42%
issues.what: the wall texture is stretched and smeared vertically, with blurry streaks instead of rock detail at native size
issues.fix: use triplanar or properly scaled rock textures on the vertical faces

issues.where: the right side fog and rock, crop x 83 to 100% y 58 to 75% (also set-B-02 crop x 83 to 100% y 25 to 42%)
issues.what: the fog is a flat uniform grey tint with no variation in density or light, and the rock behind it is a soft blob
issues.fix: add density variation and light shafts to the fog and keep some rock edge definition

issues.where: the long-necked creature in the haze at upper left
issues.what: the silhouette is smooth and featureless with no shading variation, and its feet are lost in the haze so it is unclear whether it stands on the ground
issues.fix: add subtle surface variation and ground contact for the creature
